newsitem.title: USA: TransAmerican to buy GATX La. terminal.
newsitem.headline: TransAmerican to buy GATX La. terminal.

text.p: TransAmerican Refining Corp said Friday it would buy GATX Corp subsidiary GATX Terminals Corp's Mississippi terminal in Norco, La., for an undisclosed amount.

The company said the transaction includes 5.5 million barrels of crude oil, storage tanks, docks and support facilities. It added that the facilities are next to its 200,000 barrels-a-day refinery, which is getting ready to operate.
A TransAmerican spokesman said the refinery should be fully operational by the end of the first quarter of 1998. He declined to comment on the terms of the agreement to buy the Norco terminal.
The company said in a statement the acquisition of the GATX terminal could reduce costs, as the company's current operating budget includes expenses for leasing tank storage facilities.
It added the completion of the refinery's construction project will add more than 700 new full-time jobs to St Charles Parish, La.
TransAmerican Refining is a subsidiary of TransAmerican Energy Corp.
